subject: Leadership snapshot: QBR prep & handoffs
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Leadership snapshot: QBR prep & handoffs

Team — quick weekly snapshot ahead of the QBR kickoff next week. Keeping this tight: wins, immediate risks, and asks. I attached a one-pager and the metrics deck for your review.

WINS
- Hosted API latency improvements: 12% median token latency reduction after kernel swap on model-x (measured on production trace for 10/11–11/16).
- Dedicated onboarding: Acme Platform pilot completed validation tests; baseline throughput within 5% of target.
- Optimize recommendations: initial A/B of new batching config reduced per-token cost by ~9% on chat workloads.

RISKS
- Model rollout SLO gap: a subset of long-sequence clients (mostly batch scoring) are hitting tail latency during peak windows — we need a fallback plan for the QBR demo.
- Contract/legal redline: Acme raised a data retention concern that will affect Private deployment terms if not clarified. Legal flagged a 30-day retention clause.
- Capacity headroom: Dedicated pool utilization trending higher than forecast; if we can't shift non-critical workloads, burst capacity cost will exceed the QBR forecast.

ASKS / DECISIONS NEEDED
1) Laura: confirm whether we should include the long-sequence tail-latency mitigation as a possible demo fallback (option A: show optimized kernel + note limitation; option B: swap to smaller variant with documented latency tradeoff). Decision by EOD Friday.
2) Karthik: liaise with Sales Ops to update QBR financial slide with two capacity scenarios (baseline vs conservative) — need numbers by Mon 9am PT.
3) Jonas: coordinate with Legal on Acme retention redline; can you own the next reply to Acme Legal and propose a short-term exception path for the pilot?

Notes: I called out which slides map to each ask in the attached one-pager. The metric deck has the sampling windows and trace IDs for the latency incident (trace IDs in the appendix).

Attachments: [Attachment: QBR_onepager.pdf (PDF, 280KB)], [Attachment: metric-deck.pptx (PPTX, 3.4MB)]

—
Marcus Lin
VP, Platform & Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0132
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership snapshot: QBR prep & handoffs

Thanks Marcus — useful framing. Two quick asks from me: can you add ARR impact estimates for the two capacity scenarios (best/worst) in the metrics deck (slide 6)? Also, for the demo fallback language, prefer option B for the customer-facing part (smaller variant) but include a slide that explains the kernel optimization as an engineering win.

I'll confirm final QBR narrative after those numbers land.

Best,
Laura
CEO, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership snapshot: QBR prep & handoffs

Marcus — I can take the Acme legal thread. I'll propose a pilot-specific retention agreement (45-day max for QA telemetry) and include a rollback clause. Marcus, do you have precedent language or a short template from previous pilots? If so, drop it into the Drive link and I'll merge.

Also: regarding the tail latency, can we identify a single customer (non-critical) to switch to the smaller variant for the demo so we don't affect broader metrics? If so, name them and I'll coordinate comms.

-Jonas
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership snapshot: QBR prep & handoffs

Laura / Jonas — quick follow-up.

- ARR estimates: added a new slide (slide 6b) to metric-deck.pptx with conservative / baseline revenue exposure and perf-cost delta. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR_handoff (see file metric-deck_v2).
- Legal template: uploaded a short pilot-retention-template in the Drive folder (pilot_retention_template.docx). Jonas, feel free to slot that into the reply to legal.
- Demo candidate: flagged Acme's staging workspace as the demo target (they've agreed to pilot-specific constraints). Kevin Perez (external) is copied below; I'll loop him once we have language approved.

Inline answers to asks:
1) Demo fallback: we will present option B as the customer-facing approach and have an appendix slide for the kernel optimization as an engineering note.
2) Karthik: happy to sync offline — I'll pull the capacity numbers and share a short table by Monday 9am PT.
3) Jonas: template is in Drive; please propose wording and cc me on the legal thread.

Attachments referenced above.
